core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Healthcare; Retail Pharmacy; Personal Care & Wellness; Laboratory & Diagnostics; Generics
specialty_focus: Farmacias Similares (known as Farmacias del Dr. Simi in some countries) is a major pharmacy chain founded in Mexico in 1997. It provides low-cost generic pharmaceuticals and adjacent affordable medical consultations , operating under the famous slogan "Lo mismo pero más barato" (The same, but cheaper).
